affinity.notes: The creature is constructed primarily from floating void shards and energy.

anatomy.notes: Long limbs, claws, torso, and head remain readable through fragmentation.

archetype.notes: Assassin bruiser does not communicate the intended wrong-fold geometry-control duty.

counterplay.notes: Long claws, forward lean, and predatory proportions clearly signal fast melee threat.

finish.notes: Consistent shard language and disciplined monochrome contrast.

framing.notes: Strong full-body silhouette with controlled surrounding debris.

identity.notes: Shattered void humanoid identifies the Fracture form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T4, not exact intended tier T3.
